faq.title: Visa Processing FAQs
faq.q1: How fast are eVisa applications processed?
faq.a1: Processing times vary by destination, ranging from 24 hours for automated eVisas to standard consular timeframes for complex visas.
faq.q2: Is my personal passport information secure?
faq.a2: Yes, all uploaded documents and biometric details are protected with multi-layered encryption and shared only with accredited consular authorities.
